name: Shounan Hatsu Kare Diary
source:
Falling in love for the first time...

It’s the spring of your junior year in high school. A boy you know just asked you to go out with him and...Before you know it, you’ve got your first boyfriend! But there are many more “firsts” to experience just around the corner!

[from [url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/first-love-diaries/id866950302?mt=8]iTunes Store[/url]]
translation:
第一次坠入爱河……这是高中二年级的春天。认识的男孩向你告白，于是转眼间，你有了第一个男朋友！但前方还有许多“第一次”等着你去体验！

[译自[url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/first-love-diaries/id866950302?mt=8]iTunes Store[/url]]
